definition: Per-cycle capacity label replicated on telemetry rows
derivation_method: Take one value per (dataset, cell, cycle); already constant per cycle
assumptions: NASA vs 2.0 Ah test; Na-ion pkl export; B5 trapezoid from conditional A-unit current; B1 label is wrong-cycle
missing_data_behavior: NaN only when cycle fully missing (none except B5 cycle40 label handled separately)
numerical_checks: nunique per cycle == 1 (verified); nominal implied = 1.25/2.0/1.0 exactly
leakage_risk: None as a target; do NOT use as a feature
next_action: Use NASA/Na-ion as targets; B5 with CONDITIONAL tag; drop B1 label; emit one row per cycle

derivation_method: Computed in master as cap/rated*100; confirmed residual < 1e-4
assumptions: Semantics = fraction of RATED nominal, NOT retention vs measured BOL; can exceed 100% (NASA B0006 early)
missing_data_behavior: B5 cycle40 soh is NaN while cap exists (partial label)
leakage_risk: Target leakage if used as feature on same cycle
next_action: Document semantics; compute retention_vs_BOL separately for fade analysis

definition: capacity_k / capacity at first observed cycle * 100 (proxy)
derivation_method: Divide per-cycle capacity by each cell's earliest observed capacity
assumptions: First observed cycle is NOT guaranteed the true BOL (esp. B5, Na-ion)
missing_data_behavior: Undefined for B1 (single cycle); Na-ion only 25 of 91 cycles ingested
numerical_checks: Monotone check on NASA; Na-ion change < 1.5 pp over 25 cycles
next_action: Label clearly as proxy; do not call it BOL retention

derivation_method: Groupby (cell, cycle) aggregation
assumptions: None beyond per-cycle grouping
next_action: Add per-phase (charge/discharge) voltage stats for mixed-phase sources

definition: Resampled V vs normalized time curve per cycle
derivation_method: Normalize time by (t - t_min)/(t_max - t_min); resample to a common grid
assumptions: time_sec is cumulative for B5/Na-ion/B1 - MUST subtract per-cycle min first
missing_data_behavior: Different sampling density and step counts per source
numerical_checks: Interpolate on finite values only; guard zero time span
next_action: Use per-cycle-relative time; keep source-specific grids or resample explicitly

definition: mean/min/max/std of current, split by sign (charge/discharge)
derivation_method: Groupby aggregation on I<0 and I>0 subsets
assumptions: Sign convention: I<0 discharge, I>0 charge (NASA, B5); B1/Na-ion mixed; NASA +tail is ~14 mA noise
missing_data_behavior: Charge stats are noise-only for NASA; absent for B5
next_action: Always split by phase; do not mix charge and discharge current stats

derivation_method: Per-cycle span
assumptions: time_sec is absolute for B5/Na-ion/B1, so use span not max
next_action: Use span; verify negative/zero spans (none found)

definition: integral of |I| dt over rows with I<0
derivation_method: trapezoidal integral of |I| over t on I<0 rows, /3600
assumptions: Requires verified current units; LFP header I(A/cm2) numerically equals A but is unverified
numerical_checks: B5 median 1.16 Ah matches capacity; Na-ion ~0.88 Ah per half-cycle
leakage_risk: High if target is capacity (same-cycle integration)
next_action: Keep as feature only with cycle-level target collapsed; flag LFP unit caveat

definition: integral of I dt over rows with I>0 (net charge)
derivation_method: trapezoidal integral of I over t on I>0 rows, /3600
assumptions: Only meaningful where a real charge phase exists
missing_data_behavior: Zero for B5 (discharge-only); noise for NASA
numerical_checks: Na-ion pkl charge_capacity agrees with integration
next_action: Compute only for B1/Na-ion; exclude NASA noise and B5
